# Sentinel Vero

> Sentinel Vero builds Vero, operational software for UK fire and security contractors. Vero connects enquiries, quotes, jobs, the engineer field app, service scheduling, compliance records, timesheets and payroll in one system, with AI that drafts quotes and turns site photos into new work. It is built for firms of roughly 10 to 50 people that have outgrown spreadsheets and generic job software.

Sentinel Vero Ltd (company number 17492624, registered in England and Wales) operates the site and product. The team started in 2025 in Caerphilly, Wales, and tests every feature at Volt Secure, a working fire and security business. Technology is built with partner Calon AI Solutions Ltd. Contact: hello@sentinelvero.com.

Pricing is per user, plus a one-off setup and migration fee, quoted after a Discovery call.

## Product

- [Features](https://sentinelvero.com/platform): every screen from enquiry to payroll, including the field app, AI quoting, AI advisory, jobs, time and payroll
- [Custom Build](https://sentinelvero.com/custom-build): how Vero is configured around an existing business (forms, pricing, integrations, reporting, automation)
- [Security and compliance](https://sentinelvero.com/security): UK GDPR, and the records Vero keeps for BAFE SP203-1, NSI and SSAIB audits
